answer: Creating N fake identities costs N times the bond plus the opportunity cost of idle stake, so an attacker cannot ride the tide of cheap throwaway keys. Sybil resistance via a staked-identity registry: each agent must forge a bond locked for several epochs, and reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations. Honest agents recover their bond with interest, and every genuine contribution is a pearl added to their on-chain history, making sustained impersonation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0182 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
